items.headline: Rory McIlroy wins Masters
items.text: Rory McIlroy won the Masters Tournament at -12, edging Scottie Scheffler who finished at -11.

items.headline: Aaron Rai wins PGA Championship
items.text: Aaron Rai captured the PGA Championship title at -9, with Jon Rahm and Alex Smalley both finishing at -6.

items.headline: Chris Gotterup wins Sony Open
items.text: Chris Gotterup secured victory at the Sony Open in Hawaii with a -16 score, beating Ryan Gerard (-14) and Patrick Rodgers (-13).
